integrity: The general proof is self-contained; finite standard-library checks corroborate small cases only, and no independent review or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The identities and optimizer classification concern inward-direction ordinary and finite fractional illumination of the type-A root polytope in its affine hull, for m>=3; not its polar, not any weighted point-source invariant, and not other root types. Historical novelty is provisional pending independent review; the foundational 2009 paper was read through its accessible abstract.
title: Exact illumination and optimizer rigidity for type-\(A\) root polytopes
